channel.title: Pawanesh Kumar Vishwakarma: News
channel.description: News and new publications from Pawanesh Kumar Vishwakarma, Ph.D. Research Scholar at MNNIT Allahabad (egocentric vision, embodied AI, multimodal learning).

item.title: SYNAPSE published in ICPR 2026 International Workshops
item.description: Co-authored paper "SYNAPSE: Symmetric Neurograph Augmentation via Probabilistic Diffusion Learning for fMRI-Based ADHD Identification" is published in the ICPR 2026 International Workshops proceedings (Springer, LNCS vol. 17110, pp. 132-146).

item.title: EgoHAnG receives a Reproducibility Badge at ICPR 2026
item.description: Our paper EgoHAnG received a Reproducibility Badge in the 1st ICPR 2026 RRPR Reproducibility Badge initiative (Computer and Robot Vision section), recognizing the reproducibility of the work and the availability of its research artifacts.

item.title: EgoHAnG published in ICPR 2026 proceedings
item.description: Our paper "EgoHAnG: Graph-Enhanced Horizon Aware Egocentric Action Anticipation" is published in the ICPR 2026 proceedings (Springer, LNCS vol. 16820, pp. 65-80).

item.title: DEFT-DPT published in IEEE TCSVT
item.description: Our paper "DEFT-DPT: A Lightweight Multimodal Framework for Egocentric Video Action Recognition" is published in IEEE Transactions on Circuits and Systems for Video Technology (TCSVT).

item.title: Began as Senior Research Fellow at MNNIT Allahabad
item.description: Began serving as Senior Research Fellow in the Department of CSE, MNNIT Allahabad.

item.title: Qualified UGC NET June 2025 and received the NFOBC JRF award
item.description: Qualified UGC NET June 2025 for Assistant Professor, and received the National Fellowship for OBC (NFOBC) JRF award (MoSJE, Govt. of India).

item.title: Presented at RAIT 2025, IIT (ISM) Dhanbad
item.description: Presented "Action Recognition from Egocentric Videos using RGB + Depth Modalities" at the 6th RAIT 2025, IIT (ISM) Dhanbad.
